bug_fix_details.original_issue: Parent role was blocked from (1) viewing child's finance profile (student-profile endpoint), and (2) submitting payments (record_payment endpoint). Both endpoints only allowed FINANCE_ROLES.
bug_fix_details.root_cause: record_payment endpoint required FINANCE_ROLES only. student-profile endpoint didn't allow Parent role.
bug_fix_details.fix_applied: Both endpoints now accept Parent role with a children_ids guard — parents can only view/pay for their own children (checked via children_ids array). Non-child access returns 403.
bug_fix_details.verification: 12 backend tests passed, all frontend UI features verified working
